rationale_per_step.harness-state: The planner cannot plan without durable state to read and write. Everything downstream depends on it.
rationale_per_step.harness-prompts: Defines the three personas and the artifact contract the orchestration layer parses. Must exist before the layer that parses it.
rationale_per_step.harness-orchestration: Turns a merge into a reviewed draft pull request. Last piece before the loop can run at all.

notes: Bootstrap horizon, written by hand. The mix is deliberately all dx_infra because the harness does not exist yet; the planner rebalances toward the category weights once product work is selectable.
